notes: Re-checked at 17:27 against the orchestrator's DESIGN.md §3.1/§3.2 ruling of 17:24. The code is unchanged since 16:56, so all six blockers stand. (1) ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:1541 + claudeteam.ps1:161-170: the PID file names the pane's -NoExit shell, which outlives claude. Get-ClaudeTeamLivePid (:394-404) and Get-ClaudeTeamNamedProcessMap (:1259-1278; filter :44 includes powershell/pwsh) also count that shell, so a role whose claude exited stays 'running' forever and a rerun never restarts it. §3.2 now makes this binding: only a live claude/node process counts, and the PID file is removed when claude exits. Fix: in pane mode, after `& claude` returns, remove <session>.pid if it still holds $PID. In Start-ClaudeTeamRoles, count only claude.exe/node.exe --name matches as live. In Open-ClaudeTeamMissingRoles, keep a shell --name match as 'starting' only when it was created after the launch time. An idle role then reopens as a new tab. Rewrite SPW-023 to say so (WT cannot respawn in place, which is platform-only). The one-lead rule stays as it is (§3.2: Linux aligns in SPL-110, so no pending-linux row). (2) ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:1557-1560: non-lead rows remove only the hardcoded CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS. Fix: remove every key of Get-ClaudeTeamSessionEnvironment -Kinds @('lead'), as Linux claude_team_spec_env_unset lead does (SPL-104). (3) claudeteam.ps1:138-145: standalone 'claudeteam --agent <role>' runs as an agent-teams lead (lead env, no --effort). Linux claudeteam.sh:155 applies the role spec. Fix: when --agent names an enabled registry role, use that row's env kinds (lead names removed for non-leads), add --effort from the frontmatter unless given, add --teammate-mode only for the lead, keep the user's --name, and write no PID file. The alternative is a platform-only reason in SPW-020. (4) ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:44/:1265: the --name scan covers every user's processes; Linux scans this user only (pgrep -u). Fix: add ' AND SessionId=<(Get-Process -Id $PID).SessionId>' to the filter, or check GetOwner on the matches. (5) Grid rule, now binding per §3.1. Select-ClaudeTeamGrid (:833-889) targets aspect 2.5 with row-major fill (:1077-1082). Fix: switch to max area (the largest role pane with every pane >= min_role and the lead >= min_lead), then column fill, keeping the lead-top fallback. Record the switch in SPW-025, and in SPW-024 record that the tab counts differ from Linux by the WT pane-chrome estimate (platform-only). Re-run -Status and the 1K/2K/4K simulation, and include the new tab counts. (6) AGENTS.md duplicate constants: claudeteam.ps1:41 $teammateMode duplicates $ClaudeTeamLeadTeammateMode (ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:54); use the shared one at :141/:154. ClaudeTeamInstallCommon.ps1:24 $ClaudeTeamInstallCatalogPath and :38 $ClaudeTeamInstallUserClaudeDir redeclare ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1:30/:36. Declare each once in ClaudeTeamInstallCommon.ps1, which ClaudeTeamCommon.ps1 dot-sources, and reference it from there.

spec 1 roles from .claude/agents.reason: Read-ClaudeTeamFrontmatter/Get-ClaudeTeamAgentDefinitions read name, model and effort from the frontmatter (the first duplicate wins, with a WARN). Catalog rows only override enabled and remote. grid and the top-level model are not read. A catalog row without an agent file is reported as no-agent-file. 22 roles are enabled (pycore-gpu-remote is disabled).

spec 2 every role a session.reason: Pane commands are short (claudeteam.ps1 --team-pane <mode> --agent R --name ct-R). Get-ClaudeTeamRoleClaudeArguments builds --agent/--name/--effort/--permission-mode auto. The lead also gets --teammate-mode in-process and --remote-control when a remote role is enabled. The kickoff (team.kickoff vs sessions.kickoff_lead) is expanded in the pane, and every placeholder, including {task_list}, is replaced. session_env is applied after Invoke-ClaudeOfficialRestore. The remote argument carries --effort and session_env.remote as tmux -e flags.

spec 3 layout.reason: The PMv2 query is thread-scoped (SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(-4), restored in finally; GetDpiForMonitor MDT_EFFECTIVE; rcWork), and SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext is not used. Only the first call has -w/-M/--pos, with no --size. Split fractions (r-1)/r give an equal grid, and focus-pane ids follow the creation order. Calls stay under 32,767 characters, with a per-tab fallback. Hand-recomputed for the full team with the current rule: 1920x1080@100% 4 tabs (lead 102x51, roles 102x16); @125% 6 tabs (lead 100x40, roles 63x19); 2560x1440@125% 4 tabs; @150% 6 tabs (lead 100x44, roles 82x22); 3840x2160@150% 2 tabs (lead 100x70, roles 86x22, then a 4x4 tab of 67x16). The lead is always >= 100x30, roles are >= 60x15, and every enabled role is placed exactly once. laravel-remote appears only as its ssh-loop pane. The DPI-failure fallback is 1 tab per group, per the spec. Exceeding the spec's typical tab counts is legitimate (min sizes plus WT chrome). The §3.1 switch must keep these minimums.

spec 4 prerequisites.reason: Only missing items are repaired: node, git, WT (winget; WARN below 1.21 or when the version is unknown, via [version]::TryParse, no regex), python (the Store alias is skipped), 5 dirs and PATH. user_settings_merge keys are inserted as text only when absent and validated before the write; a differing value is kept and reported. The Remote Control check is report-only and mirrors cci_check_remote_control_env, plus the isolatePeerMachines/disableRemoteControl report.
